messages:
Mia: OK team, office bracket challenge kickoff! $10 buy-in, winner gets the glory and a coffee run from the losers. Sign up here: https://forms.redwood/bracket :trophy:
Sam: count me in. Quick Q: is it best-of-one or aggregate?
Jordan: single-elimination. Also, tie-breaker is total points in the final game. Don't forget to submit picks before Thursday 3pm.
Priya: claim: organizing sheet. I can export results to the #random channel after each round.
Omar: trash talk thread initiated: Im benching morale but not my picks. @Sam youre going down :smirk: 
bracket-bot: Reminder: bracket submissions close in 48 hours. Current entries: 6. To join, DM Mia the screenshot of your bracket.
Sam: Also can we do a mini-pool for highest-scoring player each round? $2 optional side pot. Reply "side: yes" to join.
Mia: side: yes (I'm in)
Jordan: side: yes. Also will sponsor a post-finals pastry spread if I win.
Priya: Quick logistics: finals watch at the kitchen big screen? 6pm kickoff sounds good. I'll bring napkins.
Omar: Can someone remind me how to export the bracket CSV? @Priya I can help with the automation if you want.
Priya: Thanks! If you automate, please keep the results thread cleanjust one message per round update.
Sam: Final note: no late edits. Were enforcing the honor system. May the best hot-take survive. :basketball:
